temp_pivot: Create a temporary pivot that drives the selected controls as one transform.
Run the tool again to finish the active pivot session.
last_object: Create the temporary pivot at the last selected object's pivot.
centered: Create the temporary pivot at the center of the current selection.
worldspace: Create a temporary pivot aligned to world axes.
edit: Select and edit the active temporary pivot without ending the session.
reset: Reset the active pivot to its original placement and orientation.
